summary: Re-review of the S2 remediation at 4326142c. I withdraw the contested findings F1, F2, F3, F5, and F6 because each Green contest holds, and the adversarial F1 is resolved while the adversarial F2 is correctly recorded in the plan phase note. One new blocker stands: the adv 7 pin does not count or strip a mid-line or multi-line disable comment, so a pinned carrier can hide a new live oxlint finding behind either form while the guard passes (A4). The parallel adversarial run committed the failing guard adv 9 after my HEAD (490af011) and its live controls prove oxlint honors both evading forms; the defect sits in the remediation lines at my HEAD (directiveKindsOfFile, scripts/__tests__/oxc-toolchain-gates.test.ts:981-1005; stripDisableComments, lines 907-913). No current carrier uses either form, so the recorded phase state stays true. The full scripts suite at the audited HEAD is 55 passed, 1 failed (only the pre-existing remediate-concept-blueprints row); my heavy-run.sh run picked up the parallel commits and shows 56 passed, 2 failed (adv 9 plus the known row).
blocking_findings: F7 [Blocker] review-a: the allow-list pin of adv 7 does not count or strip a mid-line or multi-line disable comment, so a pinned carrier file can hide a new live oxlint finding behind either form while adv 7 passes. directiveKindsOfFile (scripts/__tests__/oxc-toolchain-gates.test.ts:981-1005 at the audited HEAD) counts only a whole-line block comment (WHOLE_LINE_DISABLE_RE, line 901) and a // -trailing comment, and stripDisableComments (lines 907-913) strips only those two forms. oxlint 1.93.0 honors both evading forms: the live controls of adv 9 (committed after the audited HEAD, at 490af011) pass, hiding no-unused-vars behind a seeded mid-line 'const keep = 1; /* eslint-disable */' and a multi-line form with exit 0, and the committed guard fails at 'directiveKindsOfFile must count the mid-line or multi-line directive: expected +0 to be 1' (my full-suite run). I re-ran the strip logic of the audited HEAD directly: both stripped copies keep the disable comment, so the sweep's temp copy stays suppressed and the hidden rule never surfaces. No current carrier uses either form (the in-code claim at lines 898-899 holds; my kinds recount matched all 49 entries exactly), so the recorded phase state stays true, but the guard that PM option B relies on is evadable. Rationale: route to Green: widen WHOLE_LINE_DISABLE_RE, directiveKindsOfFile, and stripDisableComments to count and strip mid-line and multi-line block comments, so the already-committed adv 9 passes.
